title: Refund Policy
subtitle: Clear, fair, and transparent refund guidelines for Toolify—built and maintained by Kawsar—so you always know how billing and requests work.
highlightBoxDesc: Reach out promptly with your order details if an issue happens with billing or access. Fair cases are reviewed personally by Kawsar and our support team.

eligible.title: Eligible Cases
eligible.description: Duplicate charges, accidental double billing, or major technical access issues that prevent you from using paid features.

nonRefundable.title: Non-Refundable Cases
nonRefundable.description: Partially used billing cycles, change of mind after extended usage, or accounts suspended due to terms violations.

processing.title: Resolution & Timeline
processing.description: Approved refunds are issued back to the original payment method within a standard processing window.

timelineSubtitle: Follow these straightforward steps if you need help with a payment or subscription on Toolify.

steps.title: Check Your Billing Details
steps.description: Note your account email, payment date, transaction reference, and the specific issue you experienced.

steps.title: Contact Support Quickly
steps.description: Submit your request through our support page as soon as possible so we can investigate while records are clear.

steps.title: Case Review by Kawsar & Team
steps.description: We review usage logs, billing status, and eligibility fairly without automated runaround.

steps.title: Confirmation & Settlement
steps.description: Once approved, you receive a confirmation update and the refund is processed back to your payment source.

contact.title: Need Billing Assistance?
contact.description: Have a question about a payment, plan upgrade, or refund eligibility on Toolify? Connect with Kawsar and our support team.
contact.ownerNote: Managed by Kawsar • Toolify Billing & Support
